steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0013_v10_synthesis_quality_forensics and t0014_v11_decoder_fix_retrain are completed and produced audio_quality_check.py, infer_styletts2.py, and kokoro-v11-best.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create task folder structure and initial files.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Not included: this is an empirical debugging/forensics task (duration-predictor calibration, alignment-matrix plumbing, inference-parameter sweep) about this project's own checkpoints and code. No published-paper evidence bears on the specific root cause; StyleTTS2 background is already in the project corpus from prior dependency tasks.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Not included: task_description.md already specifies the exact reproduction recipe, the parameters to sweep, and even names the ASR library (faster-whisper) already vendored as a dependency in t0008's environment. No new external research is needed to execute the diagnostic and gate-hardening work.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0013's infer_styletts2.py and audio_quality_check.py and t0014's training config/logs (ignore_modules, Stage 2 epoch logs) to understand the reusable inference recipe and whether predictor/predictor_encoder received gradient updates during t0014's finetune.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Design the sequenced forensics plan: reproduce/characterize across varied texts, localize the bug via pred_dur/frame-count logging, sweep inference parameters, conditionally apply the cheap fix or document a negative result, then harden and regression-test audio_quality_check.py.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Not included: task_description.md states no GPU is required for the diagnostic, localization, and inference-parameter-sweep work; escalation to GPU-based predictor/predictor_encoder retraining is explicitly scoped out as a follow-up task, not attempted here.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Run the varied-text characterization sweep with pred_dur/frame-count instrumentation, localize the blowup, sweep alpha/beta/diffusion_steps/embedding_scale, apply the cheap fix (or document why it failed), and extend audio_quality_check.py with duration-sanity and silence-gap signals plus a three-way v10/v11/corrected regression check.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Not included: no remote machine was provisioned (setup-machines not included), so there is nothing to tear down.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Consider alternative diagnostic angles and gate-hardening options beyond the scripted checklist -- e.g. other failure classes an ASR-round-trip check would catch that duration-sanity/silence-gap signals would not, and whether the blowup could be text-length dependent in a non-obvious way.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write duration_blowup_diagnosis.md, results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, and metrics.json documenting the root cause, whether it is universal or text-dependent, and whether the cheap inference-parameter fix worked.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Not included: this task produces internal forensic evidence (pred_dur/frame-count instrumentation, inference-parameter sweep results, gate regression checks) about this project's own checkpoint and code, not quantitative results comparable to a published baseline.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Formulate follow-up suggestions, in particular proposing the hardened gate as the project's standard pre-completion check and, if the cheap fix fails, filing the targeted predictor/predictor_encoder fine-tuning recommendation as a new follow-up task.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Final verification pass, session capture, and reporting.
